responses: Hello! 👋 How can I help you today?
I am ChatBuddy, an AI programming assistant built using Python, Flask, SQLite and Llama.
I am ChatBuddy! I can explain programming concepts, generate code, debug programs, explain errors and help you learn programming.
You can ask me to explain programming concepts, generate code, debug code, fix errors, explain code line by line, or learn Python, Java, C, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and SQL.
Python is a beginner-friendly, high-level programming language known for its simple and readable syntax. You can also ask me to generate or debug Python code.
Programming is the process of writing instructions that tell a computer how to perform a task. I can also help you write and debug programs.
Flask is a lightweight Python web framework used to create web applications. This chatbot itself uses Flask for its backend.
A database is a system used to store, organize and retrieve information. This project uses SQLite to store chatbot conversations.
SQLite is a lightweight database system that stores the database in a single file. This project uses db.sqlite to store chat history.
A chatbot is a software application that communicates with users through text or voice. This project combines a Python web application with a local Llama model.
College projects are a great way to improve your programming skills. You can ask me to help with programming assignments and projects.
I can help with programming, code generation, debugging, code explanation and general programming questions.
